_meta.description: Tap to keep a barn owl in the air and slip between the spiked pipes. Challenge friends to ATTACK over Game Center or iMessage, earn medals, and climb the Game Center leaderboard. No ads, no in-app purchases.
_title: Wise Flyer - One Tap, One Owl, One More Try
attack-mode-with-a.2ce6b8: ATTACK mode with a match waiting for your turn
blaine-miller-all-rights.b327c2: © Blaine Miller. All rights reserved.
bronze-at-5-silver.4a0dcc: Bronze at 5, silver at 15, gold at 30 and platinum at 50. Your best score goes on the Game Center leaderboard.
each-tap-lifts-the.25380d: Each tap lifts the owl, and gravity does the rest. Every gate you clear is a point, and the pipes never run out.
how-do-i-play.f07bc7: How do I play Wise Flyer?
is-wise-flyer-available.ed6ae7: Is Wise Flyer available in the European Union?
one-tap-one-owl.f6ca91: One tap. One owl. One more try.
simple-to-learn-challenging.9258cc: Simple to learn, challenging to master, impossible to put down
simply-tap-the-screen.e5f71a: Simply tap the screen to make the owl flap and fly upward. Release to let gravity bring you down. Navigate through obstacles by timing your taps carefully. It's easy to learn but challenging to master!
take-turns-trying-to.68181e: Take turns trying to beat each other's score. Miss and you earn a letter, and the first to spell ATTACK loses.
tap-to-keep-a.337c1f: Tap to keep a barn owl in the air, slip through the gaps between the spiked pipes, and see how far you get.
the-game-over-card.e13cc6: The game over card with a medal, the score and the best score
the-global-leaderboard-tracks.39934e: The global leaderboard tracks high scores from players around the world. Your best score is automatically submitted, and you can see where you rank against other players. Climb the ranks by improving your skills!
the-owl-flying-between.a8640f: The owl flying between spiked pipes, the score behind it
the-owl-waiting-to.9abf0f: The owl waiting to take off over a city at night
wise-flyer-is-a.68e6a8: Wise Flyer is a one-time purchase on the App Store. No subscriptions, nothing to unlock.
yes-wise-flyer-can.52a69d: Yes! Wise Flyer can be played completely offline. Leaderboard features require an internet connection, but the core gameplay works anywhere, anytime.
yes-wise-flyer-is.1a458a: Yes. Wise Flyer is on the App Store everywhere in the European Union, France included. It's available in every App Store territory Apple offers except Indonesia.
yes-wise-flyer-runs.9f9eec: Yes. Wise Flyer runs on iPhone and iPad, and the game scales to fit any window, including Split View and Stage Manager.
